gloss: here and there; all over the place

definitions.gloss: here and there; all over; in every direction
definitions.explanation: Refers to many scattered places at once, or to moving between them. Casual in tone; it works both as an adverb of place and as a noun taking particles.

examples.japanese: あっちこっち⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked all over the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あっちこっち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There are books lying around all over the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧、あっちこっち⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}っている→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暮|く}れた。
examples.english: I got lost, and while I was wandering around here and there the sun went down.

notes:
A casual doubling of ⟦あっち→あっち：02891_acchi⟧ (over there) and ⟦こっち→こっち：02903_kocchi⟧ (over here). Note the order: Japanese says "there and here," the reverse of the English idiom.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あっちこっち⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search everywhere
- あっちこっち⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go all over
- あっちこっち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: scattered in various places
- あっちこっち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from all directions

REGISTER:
あっちこっち is conversational. The neutral equivalent is ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧, and ⟦{方々|ほうぼう}→方々：00116_houbou⟧ is the formal written form; use one of those in writing or polite speech.
